seed.name: Order Type Definition
seed.description: Defines the Order type that every order in the flow is built from. Its status is tracked as a string so the order's current stage is always known, and its items are tracked as a list so any number of line items can be attached, from a single item up to the full order.
seed.code:
def create_order(status: str, items: list):
    order = Order()
    order.status = status
    order.items = items

    return order

seed.name: Item Type Definition
seed.description: Defines the Item type that each line item in an order is built from. Its name is tracked as a string for identification, its price as a number per unit, and its quantity as a number of units ordered — all three are required for the item to be priced and counted correctly later in the flow.
seed.code:
def create_item(name: str, price: int, quantity: int):
    item = Item()
    item.name = name
    item.price = price
    item.quantity = quantity

    return item

seed.name: Item Total Calculation
seed.description: Computes the total cost of a single line item, used as the building block for the order's subtotal. The total is always the item's price multiplied by its quantity, and is recalculated whenever either value changes.

seed.name: Invalid Item Price Validation
seed.description: Guards against items entering the flow with a negative price, which would otherwise corrupt every downstream total. Whenever an item's price is less than 0, the flow refuses to continue and throws "INVALID_PRICE".

seed.name: Invalid Item Quantity Validation
seed.description: Guards against items entering the flow with a quantity that makes no sense to order. Whenever an item's quantity is less than or equal to 0, the flow refuses to continue and throws "INVALID_QUANTITY".

seed.name: Order Subtotal Calculation
seed.description: Computes the order's subtotal before tax and discount are applied. The subtotal is the sum of every line item's total, so it is only accurate once each item's own total has already been calculated.

seed.name: Order Tax Calculation
seed.description: Computes the tax owed on an order, applied as a flat 8% of its subtotal. The subtotal must already be calculated for this value to be correct.

seed.name: Order Discount Default
seed.description: Sets the starting point for every order's discount before any bulk-order rules run. The discount defaults to 0, so an order only ends up with a discount if a later rule explicitly grants one.

seed.name: Bulk Order Discount
seed.description: Rewards large orders with a bulk discount. Whenever an order's subtotal is greater than or equal to 1000, its discount is set to 10% of that subtotal, overriding the default of 0.

seed.name: No Discount Below Threshold
seed.description: Makes explicit that orders below the bulk threshold get no discount. Whenever an order's subtotal is less than 1000, its discount is set to 0, so the bulk discount rule never leaves a stale value in place when an order falls under the limit.

seed.name: Order Total Calculation
seed.description: Computes the final amount owed for an order. The total is the subtotal plus tax minus discount, and depends on all three of those values already being calculated.

seed.name: Order Item Count Calculation
seed.description: Computes how many units are in an order in total, used later to flag orders that exceed the item limit. The item count is the sum of the quantities of every item on the order, not the number of distinct line items.

seed.name: Order Audit Flag
seed.description: Flags high-value orders for manual review. Whenever an order's total is greater than 1000, the order is marked as requiring an audit; otherwise it is explicitly marked as not requiring one, so the flag always reflects the order's current total rather than a leftover value.

seed.name: Invalid Order Total Validation
seed.description: Catches orders that have ended up with a negative total, which should never happen but would otherwise pass through undetected. Whenever an order's total is less than 0, the flow refuses to continue and throws "INVALID_ORDER_TOTAL".

seed.name: Order Item Limit Validation
seed.description: Enforces a cap on how many units a single order can contain. Whenever an order's item count is greater than 100, the flow refuses to continue and throws "ORDER_LIMIT_EXCEEDED", and depends on the item count already being calculated.

seed.name: Cannot Ship Empty Order Validation
seed.description: Prevents an order from being marked as shipped when it has nothing in it. Whenever an order's status is "SHIPPED" and its item count is 0, the flow refuses to continue and throws "CANNOT_SHIP_EMPTY_ORDER".
